headline: Mooring County Widens Colonial Lead as Linn Mercy Stirs Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition Mooring County has tipped further Colonial: where the margin stood six posts to five, the count now reads eight to four, and the fighting there has thickened rather than slackened, the hourly casualty roll climbing past a thousand with flags still moving within the hour of this dispatch, The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest grounds. Weathered Expanse tells a quieter story — one more post has slipped into no-man's-land, leaving three Colonial, two Warden and four in ruin, though the guns there have cooled markedly from the earlier surge. Linn Mercy, still at our last writing, has come alive: some three dozen base actions in a day, a single Warden flag once more flying among nine Colonial, and Lathair and Outwich Ranch the most disputed grounds. Marban Hollow now leans Warden four posts to three with one base in ruin, while Callums Cape's furious pace has cooled to a fraction of yesterday's. Callahans Passage and Nevish Line show no fresh flag movement; Stlican Shelf saw a brief exchange at Briar, yet all nine posts remain Colonial. Four of every five strategic posts across the map fly Colonial colours. It is the 808th day of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
